run_libsize_check: run libsize.py on a .so file to display its current size in bytes
run_libsize_compare: run libsize.py with a save file to compare current .so size against a previously recorded size
run_libsize_baseline: run libsize.py on a new .so file to create a baseline size record for future comparison
run_libsize_regression: run libsize.py to detect size regressions or reductions in compiled shared object files
run_libsize_report: run libsize.py to get a percentage change report between the old and new .so file sizes
